description: Least-privilege capability for the main window. Autostart permissions are deliberately absent: the webview no longer calls the autostart plugin at all, because a direct enable()/disable() registers the path of the *running* executable and a click during `tauri dev` would point the OS at src-tauri/target/debug and overwrite the installed app's launch entry. The Rust side owns that write and refuses it in a development build (src-tauri/src/autostart.rs), so the frontend needs no plugin permission for it — the surface shrinks and the hazard disappears together.
